trial_court: High Court of Manipur at Imphal
case_name: Khundongbam Joychandra Meitei vs The Officer-In-Charge

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Khundongbam Joychandra Meitei, aged about 26 years, S/o Kh. Ibothoi Singh, a resident of Thoubal Kiyam Siphai Khudongbam Leikai, P.O. & P.S. Thoubal, District Thoubal, Manipur.
parties.respondent_defendant: 1. The Officer-in-Charge, Women Police Station, Bishnupur, P.O. & P.S.- Bishnupur, Bishnupur District, Manipur; 2. Julia Pukhrambam, aged about 26 years, D/o P. Shantikumar Singh, a resident of Naranseina Awang Leikai, P.O. & P.S. Moirang, Bishnupur District, Manipur-795133.

facts_of_case: The petitioner has been in a relationship with the victim for around 10 years and eloped on 22.11.2018. The victim lodged a complaint stating that she was raped by the petitioner saying he would marry her, but instead, he committed rape.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the accused to prove that the anticipatory bail was granted in accordance with law.
legal_principles.held: Per contra, Mr. H. Samarjit, the learned Additional Public Prosecutor submitted that the petitioner and his parents all know that they have done the Court marriage.

legal_principles.principle: The validity of a Court marriage is crucial in determining the legal status of a couple.
legal_principles.held: He further submits that the petitioner and his parents all know that they have done the Court marriage.
